methodologyNotes: 13 notable e-readers compared by buyers in 2026. Specs sourced from manufacturer product pages (BOOX shop.boox.com), Wikipedia device articles, and independent reviews (Digital Trends, GoodEReader, AndroidAuthority). US MSRP / launch price used; where prices changed after launch the launch price is noted. Battery life in weeks reflects manufacturer claim or reviewer-confirmed figure; null where no credible week-count was found. Waterproof = true only for certified IP ratings (IPX8); water-repellent designs = false. Color E Ink panels noted via color_display boolean. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

The official pocketbook.ch Era Color spec table confirms a 7'' (17.8 cm) E Ink Kaleido 3 display, PPI 300 (greyscale) / 150 (RGB), 32 GB internal storage, adaptive SMARTlight with a warm or cool frontlight tone, IPX8 water protection ("Water protection Yes (IPX8)"), side control buttons, "Up to one month of battery life", and a retail set of e-reader + USB Type-C cable + documents (no stylus). products.name: Barnes & Noble Nook GlowLight 4
products.priceNote: US price $149.99 from the Barnes & Noble official product page (barnesandnoble.com), which shows "NOOK GlowLight 4 ... $149.99" and "6" eReader NOOK GlowLight 4 $ 149.99 Ships Free". Premium Members save 10%.
products.provenance: Barnes & Noble's official product page confirms the NOOK GlowLight 4 is a 6" eReader with 32GB of storage and physical page-turning buttons at $149.99 US ("6" eReader NOOK GlowLight 4 $ 149.99 Ships Free"), and its device-comparison labels the separate GlowLight 4 Plus (not this model) as "Waterproof", so waterproof=false for the 6" GlowLight 4; the same comparison reserves "Vivid Color" for the NOOK tablets while this device is described only as an E Ink "paper-like reading experience" reader, so color_display=false. The Amazon retailer listing (Model Name NOOK GlowLight 4, Model Number BNRV1100 — this exact unit) states verbatim "A 6" high-resolution 300-dpi screen", "Screen Size 6 Inches", "Memory Storage Capacity 32 GB", and "physical page-turning buttons", plus a complete "What's in the box"/Included Components list (USB-C cable, quick start guide, rechargeable battery, built-in anti-glare screen protector, one year limited warranty) with no stylus, confirming stylus_included=false. releaseDate and specs.release were NULLED: the string "2021" appears nowhere on either fetched page, and the prior 2021 justification relied on the B&N Help Center, which was not among the verified URLs. battery_weeks is null because the pages state only "read for weeks on a single charge" (Amazon lists "720 Hours"/"approximately one month") with no explicit week count, and warm_light is null because no adjustable warm/amber front-light spec was stated verbatim (only a software "Night Mode" warm sepia tone). color_display=false as a monochrome E Ink eReader with no color panel claimed.
